The House Amp pedal captures that charm, bringing the quirks of a busted backline amp straight to your pedalboard. Whether you’re chasing gritty fuzz, lo-fi textures, or blown-out chaos, this pedal delivers a sound that feels alive and unpredictable. Mid-Fi Electronics House Amp Pedal Review This pedal isn’t just another fuzzits a character machine. The Amp Volume control dials in the amount of fuzz, while Woofer/Horn lets you blend between full-range and high-passed signals for different tonal textures. Speaker Trouble introduces unpredictable breakup, simulating the sound of an amp on its last legs. A final Master control lets you tame the madness. If you love lo-fi, garage rock, or just weird, raw tones, the House Amp is your new best friend. Mid-Fi Electronics House Amp Pedal Features Captures the gritty, unpredictable sound of old, broken amps Fuzz control lets you dial in anything from subtle grit to full-on destruction Unique blend control mixes between full-range and high-passed signals Speaker Trouble knob adds blown-out textures and wild sonic artifacts Compact and rugged build, perfect for experimental sounds on the go Mid-Fi Electronics House Amp Pedal Specs Runs on a standard 9V DC power supply Four interactive controls for fuzz, blend, breakup, and volume Built with high-quality components for a reliable, road-worthy design True bypass switching for a clean signal when disengaged What’s in the box of our Mid-Fi Electronics House Amp Pedal?
